inlines.v: HERB'AL, noun A book that contains the names and descriptions of plants, or the classes, genera, species and qualities of vegetables. 1. A hortus siccus, or dry garden; a collection of specimens of plants, dried and preserved. HERB'AL, adjective Pertaining to herbs.
